nodes.label: pdk_edit_custom_code capability
nodes.rationale: No administrator fallback: only the explicit per-user capability grants code read/write, because write access to custom-functions.php is effectively server code execution.

nodes.label: Agent trust boundary
nodes.rationale: Agent can only read/overwrite three whitelisted files; double capability check, PHP parse check and .bak backup limit damage.

nodes.label: WordPress Abilities API
nodes.rationale: Plugin speaks no MCP itself; an MCP server plugin exposes registered abilities as tools.

nodes.label: Always-on (non-toggleable) module
nodes.rationale: A handler that must work when things fail cannot depend on reading an option; wrong status code is a defect, not a preference.

nodes.label: Section-as-grid layout (full/wide/popout/content lanes)
nodes.rationale: Ryan Mulligan layout-breakouts pattern; all layout in :where() for zero specificity.

nodes.label: Unlayered CSS (no @layer)
nodes.rationale: Oxygen Modern Normalize sets *{margin:0} unlayered; layered rules would always lose, so file stays unlayered and wins by order.

nodes.label: sync_oxygen() Oxygen variable sync
nodes.rationale: One-way sync via internal Breakdance saveVariables(); guards against {} payload and silent wipe of all variables.

nodes.label: Line-height ratio (ink guard)
nodes.rationale: calc(1em+0.25rem) gave 1.07x on large h1, descenders touched next line; ratio >= 1.1 keeps ink apart.

nodes.label: File integrity check (SHA-256 pdk_file_hashes)
nodes.rationale: Files modified outside the plugin editor are not loaded; protects against out-of-band tampering, not against authorized writers.

nodes.label: PDK storage dir (uploads/pdk-theme-options)
nodes.rationale: Customer code lives outside plugin/theme dirs so it survives plugin updates and theme switches.

nodes.label: PDK_Settings::WC_MODULES WooCommerce gate
nodes.rationale: Without WooCommerce, is_module_enabled() returns false but stored preference is preserved.

nodes.label: Blocklist-not-allowlist pattern
nodes.rationale: New items (sizes, library files) are active by default; only explicitly disabled entries are stored.

nodes.label: PDK Elementen Element Studio save location
nodes.rationale: Oxygen first-party folders are overwritten on update; registered on breakdance_loaded prio 9 because Oxygen scans at 10.
nodes.norm_label: pdk elementen element studio save location

nodes.label: Shared periods list (afwijkende periodes)
nodes.rationale: Single source for closures: drives opening hours, delivery non-shipping days and vacation-mode shop closure, so a closure is entered once.
